high_level_description: The image features two t-shirts displayed against an orange background. The t-shirt on the left is solid blue with a textured pattern that resembles a woven or mesh design. On the front of this shirt, the word "BLACK PANTHER" is printed in a stylized font with a gradient effect, transitioning from yellow to orange. The t-shirt on the right is also blue but features a more detailed and vibrant graphic. The graphic depicts a character resembling Black Panther, a superhero from the Marvel Comics universe.
